search.snippet: Redberry pie is a pie that can be created at level 10 Cooking. The pie heals 125 life points when a half is consumed. Therefore, one pie heals a total of 250 life points. The pie is used in The Knight's Sword to bribe Thurgo, an Imcando dwarf, to help you make a blurite sword.

search.snippet: A waterskin carries up to four servings of water, and provides protection against the desert heat effect in the Kharidian Desert. The amount of water will be noted by the waterskins name in parenthesis e.g. "Waterskin" is a waterskin that is holding the maximum amount of water.

search.snippet: Waterskins carry up to four servings of water, and provides protection against the desert heat effect in the Kharidian Desert. Without a waterskin, players will lose health due to dehydration. Without them, the desert is a more dangerous place.
